title: Fantastic Mr Fox
author: Roald Dahl
description: Mr. Fox is an extremely clever anthropomorphized fox. In order to feed his family, he steals food from the cruel, brutish farmers named Boggis, Bunce, and Bean every night.

title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
description: 16-year-old Katniss Everdeen, who lives far in the future of North America. The Capitol exercises political control over the rest of the nation by creating The Hunger Games. An annual battle royale to the death.

title: It Ends with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Lily Bloom moves to Boston and starts building the life she wants. When she meets neurosurgeon Ryle Kincaid, a new relationship begins. However, the return of her first love, Atlas Corrigan, and troubling patterns in her relationship force Lily to make difficult decisions about love, family, and her future.

title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
author: Sarah J. Maas
description: Feyre is a young huntress struggling to support her family. After she kills a wolf in the woods, a powerful faerie takes her to the magical land of Prythian. As she learns more about her captor and his world, she discovers a dangerous threat that could destroy everything she has come to care about.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid
author: Jeff Kinney
description: Greg Heffley records his experiences of middle school through journal entries and cartoons. Alongside his best friend Rowley Jefferson, he faces friendship problems, embarrassing situations, and attempts to become popular. Greg's plans rarely go as expected, making everyday school life a series of funny adventures.

title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
author: George Orwell
description: Winston Smith lives in a society where the Party controls information, rewrites history, and watches its citizens through constant surveillance. While working at the Ministry of Truth, Winston secretly begins questioning the government. His search for freedom and his relationship with Julia place him in danger under the rule of Big Brother.
